caption: The drawing depicts a large, round, metal pot with a rough, mottled brownish-gray surface. The pot has thick walls and sits on three short cylindrical legs. On opposite sides of the pot, there are small, triangular-shaped handles that are attached near the rim, allowing for lifting or carrying. The interior of the pot is shaded darkly, suggesting depth, while the exterior displays varied tones and textures indicating the metal's weathered appearance. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details, and the pot is centered in the composition. Near the bottom, underneath the pot, the name "Violet Hofenstein" is written in small, neat text.
title: Dutch Bake Oven
